at 2026-07-15T12:00:00Z

# The first board defaults to the initialized project directory basename.
mkdir inferred-project
cd inferred-project
exec git init -b main
exec card init --prefix inferred-
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/inferred-init.txt
exec card --json board list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/inferred-boards.jsonl

# Repeated initialization preserves the existing catalog even when first-init
# options request a different result.
exec card --json board create 'Second board'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/second-board.json
exec card init --board-name Renamed
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/repeated-init.txt
exec card --json init --no-board
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/repeated-init.json
exec card --json board list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/repeated-boards.jsonl
cd ..

# An external --store path does not become the project naming source.
mkdir external-store-project
mkdir external-stores
cd external-store-project
exec card --store ../external-stores/arbitrary-name --json init
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/external-store-init.json
exec card --store ../external-stores/arbitrary-name --json board list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/external-store-boards.jsonl
cd ..

# An explicit first-board name replaces inference.
mkdir explicit-project
cd explicit-project
exec git init -b main
exec card init --board-name 'Planning board'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/explicit-init.txt
exec card --json board list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/explicit-boards.jsonl
cd ..

# Non-Git projects may initialize with no board. Board creation remains an
# explicit follow-up operation.
exec card init no-board --no-board
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/no-board-init.txt
exec card --store no-board/.cardamom --json board list
! stdout .
! exec card --store no-board/.cardamom create 'Needs a board'
stderr 'board not found'
exec card --store no-board/.cardamom --json board create 'Later board'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/later-board.json

# JSON reports the project and board created by this invocation.
exec card --json init json-project --board-name 'JSON board'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/json-init.json

# Mutually exclusive and empty board names fail before creating project files.
! exec card init conflicting --board-name Board --no-board
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/conflicting-flags.txt
! exists conflicting/.cardamom
! exec card init empty-name --board-name '   '
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/empty-name.txt
! exists empty-name/.cardamom
